headline: Outlook will block .msix and .msixbundle attachments starting November
summary: Microsoft will add .msix and .msixbundle files to Outlook's list of blocked attachment types. The change takes effect next month across Outlook Web and the new Outlook Windows client.

claims.statement: Microsoft will block .msix and .msixbundle file attachments in Outlook.

sources.quote: Microsoft Outlook to block MSIX attachments starting November

claims.statement: The block applies to Outlook Web and the new Outlook Windows client, starting next month.

sources.quote: in Outlook Web and the new Outlook Windows client starting next month
